notes: §1985:VI.6.17.3 SR4: 'The description of the data item referenced by identifier-1 or any items subordinate to identifier-1 may not contain the DEPENDING phrase of the OCCURS clause' (cite.py OK). VersionConformancePass.GateInitialize calls GateCobol85VariableOccurrence for each bound INITIALIZE (one per identifier-1), which walks DataItem.SelfAndDescendantsOf(the resolved identifier-1) and raises COBOL0900 (constructs row initialize-variable-occurrence-2002, available from 2002) at the first OCCURS ... DEPENDING found; the bound-statement walk recurses every container. The witness refuses INITIALIZE G (subordinate ODO) and INITIALIZE E (1) (own ODO) and accepts INITIALIZE W-X. Probes at --std 85 (a ODO, b each operand/multi-operand, c edition, d group/elementary, e file/linkage): INITIALIZE W-X G -> COBOL0900 on G only; INITIALIZE G REPLACING NUMERIC inside IF with an ODO group subordinate -> COBOL0900; INITIALIZE H and INITIALIZE F (2) (items beside/within an ODO table, whose own descriptions have no DEPENDING) accepted and ran, DISPLAY G printed '  5Q0Q5Q'; INITIALIZE E (N) -> COBOL0900; FD record with an ODO and a LINKAGE ODO record -> COBOL0900, INITIALIZE RN accepted; a REDEFINES subordinate holding an ODO -> COBOL0855 and COBOL0900; a fixed-OCCURS group INITIALIZE ran '[   ][000     0]'; WITH FILLER/TO VALUE -> COBOL0830/0831; the same multi program at --std 2002 compiles and runs. Class f does not reach a syntax rule on the description. Read 6 (2026-11-14, records-read6): the row had no verdict and no test-ref although its witness existed; the reader read CONFORMS and an independent refuter UPHELD it (op-20261114/out-read6/rd-NN.json and rd-NN-refute.json).
